info.title: Moja kawa — Agent API
info.description: Server-to-server JSON API. Requires APP_API_TOKEN even when the PWA has no login. Changes use the same SQLite collection, history and PWA conflict protection. See /agent-api.md. No bulk overwrite or history restore endpoint is exposed to agents. Collection size must stay within 1.8 MB for PWA synchronization.
